topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Well, now, I reckoned this day would be much like any other, until you came knockin' at my door with your bold request. I've known you for a good long while, and seen you work the soil with care and respect, just as the saints would have us do. It’s true, the land is generous when we give her what she needs, and there is a part of my yard that lies a bit too fallow, shaded by the old willow tree. If you say a garden could thrive there, I’ll trust your green thumb and the Good Lord. Perhaps come spring, we'll both have a little more to lay on the table and a prayer to offer for the earth’s kindness. Let’s see what the soil holds, eh?
